summary: Iter14 testing: backend + frontend for new features (warehouse tabs + bulk-delete + delete-tag, my-assigned dropdown, vacations workflow, admin dashboard, AssignedSerialInput with barcode preview). Backend: 12/12 pytest passed in test_iter14.py covering bulk-delete (returns {deleted:N}), tags/delete (clears tipo + removes threshold, 400 on empty tag), my-assigned (401 without auth, tipo filter works, scaricato excluded), vacations CRUD (user sees only theirs, admin sees all, non-admin cannot decide=>403, invalid decision=>400, invalid dates=>400, admin_note propagates, notifications kind=vacation_request emitted for admins and kind=vacation_decision for user), admin/dashboard (403 for non-admin, full shape validated with totals+avg_completed+stock, default from/to defaults to current month). Frontend: admin login OK, all 4 nav testids present (nav-notes/nav-warehouse/nav-vacations/nav-dashboard). Vacations page loaded with vacations-page container and 2 existing vacation-row-* rows (from backend tests); vacation-submit correctly hidden for admin. Admin dashboard loaded with dashboard-from/to date pickers and 4 user-stat-* cards. Warehouse: all 4 tab testids (wh-tab-in_stock/assegnato/scaricato/all) present with wh-tab-in_stock as default active (bg-white class), wh-select-all + wh-select-{serial} checkboxes render, selecting a row reveals warehouse-bulk-delete button. Notes edit form: AssignedSerialInput wired correctly — field-cpe-{wr} input + field-cpe-{wr}-toggle-barcode reveals field-cpe-{wr}-barcode-preview containing an element (visually confirmed CPE barcode + QR rendered). Same for field-ont_sfp-{wr} and material-serial-{wr}-0. NOT tested (dependent on preexisting data or optional): warehouse-delete-tag button (no tipoFilter set — dropdown option list has no tag-chip testids; button confirmed in source and testid present). tag-chip testid does not exist in DOM (per-tag ripartizione uses different markup).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1537 lines — split into routers/models/services modules (auth, notes, inventory, vacations, dashboard, notifications).
App.js is 2294 lines — extract WarehousePage, VacationsPage, AdminDashboard, NoteCard, AssignedSerialInput into separate files.

vacation notification schema reuses note_id/note_wr fields to store vacation id — inconsistent (see iter13 code review note about _check_threshold overloading note_wr). Consider adding a generic ref_id + ref_type field to notifications.

admin_dashboard iterates all serials via async cursor and all notes with to_list(50000) — acceptable now but if serials>50k this hides ObjectId errors and grows memory. Prefer aggregation pipeline with $group on user_id.
delete_tag does not emit 'tag_removed' history events on affected serials — audit trail lost for bulk edits. Consider add_serial_event for each modified serial (like bulk_delete_serials does).
my-assigned partner logic reuses _get_team_partners with today's date — a note edit form loaded at 23:59 could differ from the request time; not a real issue but document behavior.
vacation delete: non-admin user cannot cancel their own already approved/rejected vacation (404 by design). Confirm this matches the UX expectation.
